dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could it have been because of the Glaciafruit...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: Hey! Now that you mention it, that really might be it! I must've been afraid of the cold because I was working on an empty stomach and got weak! Ah, if only I'd eaten them sooner...

dialogues.speaker: Zhuravlev
dialogues.text: All right, it's decided! Next time I go out, I'll stuff a few more of them in my pockets to keep the cold off!
